policy.description: Reviewed subjects resolve only to explicitly approved files. Rejected candidates remain quarantined even if listed by an old pack manifest.

adult-desert-armadillo.decision: Both faithful; variant 2 is the clearer primary.

animated-items.decision: The curated replacement depicts the tools themselves as the hostile animated encounter.

asaren-celpeze.decision: Only variant 2 is a large quadrupedal coastal lizard.

beltunumshi.decision: Curated replacement has stump, vines, scorch marks, eyes, and maw.

blood-wolf.decision: Bare image is the only natural red quadrupedal wolf.

blue-belly-crocodile.decision: Variant 1 best preserves an immense armored amphibious crocodile.

blue-dappled-prereni.decision: Variant 1 preserves deer anatomy and blue dappling.

cutthroat.decision: Curated replacement is the only human urban criminal; old variants are monsters.

dark-spirit.decision: Curated replacement has substance-like shadow, rags, claws, and sanguine eyes.

dark-sprite.decision: Variant 3 best preserves dark eyes, gnarled hair, black dress, and chilling expression.

elder-blue-dappled-prereni.decision: Variant 2 is the only blue-dappled elder deer.

elder-desert-armadillo.decision: Variant 2 is a single coherent plated animal.

ember-bull.decision: The curated replacement uniquely combines the correct bull anatomy, scale, fire-lined hide and horns, ash, and cinders.

field-goblin.decision: Variant 1 is the stronger wary small goblin.

fledgling-forest-gryphon.decision: Variant 2 most clearly combines feline and avian anatomy.

forest-geni.decision: Curated replacement has stocky proportions, green skin and eyes, ear bells, and leaf-bark clothing.

fuligin-umbral-moth.decision: Variant 2 is a moth; variant 1 is anthropomorphic.

giant-black-leucro.decision: Variant 2 is the canonical giant black wolf-like quadruped.

giant-thicket-viper.decision: Bare image is the only actual enormous snake.

gigantic-lachmate.decision: Variant 2 reads as an ambulatory rubbish heap; variant 1 is a boar.

gnarled-fendryad.decision: Variant 2 best preserves the emaciated faerie and skeletal vegetation.

graverobber.decision: Variant 2 is the stronger full-body filthy tomb robber.

juvenile-desert-armadillo.decision: Variant 2 is a single coherent juvenile animal.

lesser-sluagh.decision: Variant 3 is the only musclebound gray brute in ragged hide.

nipoh-oshu.decision: The curated replacement is the first candidate that is entirely vapor while retaining readable limbs and embedded eyes.

pirate.decision: Variant 2 is fully outfitted and carries the defining Red Sash.

red-gold-scaled-atik-et.decision: Variant 2 is the scaled S'Kra Mur woman with fiery crest and hand flames.

robed-dragon-priest-ess.decision: Variant 1 best preserves the deep cowl and purple hand flame.

rock-guardian.decision: The curated replacement fixes the former bird-shaped rock formations and provides the canonical monumental humanoid body.

rock-troll.decision: Variant 1 is the stronger slate-gray rock troll.

s-kra-kor-shaman.decision: The curated replacement is recognizably S'Kra Mur and preserves the hood, tail, claws, and hostile magic.

s-kra-kor-villager.decision: The curated replacement corrects both former human renders while keeping the subject visibly unarmored and villager-like.

s-kra-kor-warrior.decision: The curated replacement fixes the minotaur body-plan error and clearly preserves black scales, claws, and the spiked reptilian tail.

small-peccary.decision: Variant 1 better preserves the small dark peccary build and curved tusks.

snow-goblin.decision: Variant 2 is the only broad-torso goblin with full white hair.

spiny-bloodfish.decision: Variant 1 has the clearest spiny aquatic predator silhouette.

storm-bull.decision: Variant 2 alone shows the immense silvery bull with pearly horns and mist.

swamp-troll.decision: Variants 1 and 3 are strong humanoid conglomerations of swamp matter.

sylph.decision: Elanthipedia resolved the ambiguity; the curated replacement matches the moonsilk textile construct rather than either human candidate.

telga-orek.decision: Variant 2 preserves the gelatinous slime body.

tortured-soul.decision: Variant 1 reads as humanoid essence twisting in pain with real claws.

twisted-fendryad.decision: Variant 1 best preserves emaciated faerie anatomy and skeletal plant matter.

ur-hhrki-izh.decision: The curated replacement is the first reptilian full-body skeleton with stretched scale remnants, burning sockets, and a long tail.

void-black-umbral-moth.decision: Variant 2 is an actual black moth.

voidspawn.decision: Variant 2 gives the clearest frenzy of black wings, claws, flat face, and hateful eyes.

windbag.decision: The curated replacement restores the floating textile body, glowing eyes, and long torn cloth claws absent from both yarn-ball candidates.

wood-troll.decision: Variant 1 is the only towering bark-textured moss-furred troll.

young-blue-dappled-prereni.decision: Variant 1 preserves a youthful antlerless deer silhouette.

adult-desert-armadillo.subject: A sand-and-tan desert quadruped with articulated hide plates, a twitching snout, digging claws, and a barbed tail in the M'Riss Dunes of Despair.
adult-desert-armadillo.decision: Both are faithful plated desert animals; variant 2 is the cleaner primary and variant 1 supplies a credible more heavily barbed silhouette.

asaren-celpeze.subject: A mottled sea lizard the size of a large hunting cat, basking on ocean rocks or beaches, with a raised threat crest, switching tail, jewel-like eyes, pointed teeth, and a poisonous tail stinger.
asaren-celpeze.decision: Variant 2 alone clearly reads as a large quadrupedal coastal lizard in crest-raised threat display. The human and anthropomorphic renders are semantic mismatches; variant 4 loses too many defining threat cues.

blood-wolf.subject: A medium quadrupedal wolf with a beautiful red coat flecked with gray, a powerful build, a toothy warning smile, and a low growl; found around Wolf Clan and Aesry.
blood-wolf.decision: The bare image is the only strong red-brown natural wolf. Variant 1 is clothed and anthropomorphic; variant 2 is a generic gray husky-like portrait.

blue-dappled-prereni.subject: A small territorial deer about ten and a half hands high, with delicately pointed ears and a gray coat patterned with blue spots, on the Road to Shard.
blue-dappled-prereni.decision: Variant 1 preserves the deer anatomy and blue-dappled coat. Variant 2 reads as a rabbit-deer hybrid and omits the defining blue spots.

dark-spirit.canonicalDescription: A floating mass of swirling shadow given substance, in ragged robes, with jagged claws and glowing sanguine eyes.
dark-spirit.decision: Curated replacement has substance-like shadow, rags, claws, and sanguine eyes.

forest-geni.canonicalDescription: A stocky halfling-sized forest being with pale green eyes, faint green skin, pointed ears hung with copper bells, and rough leaf-and-bark clothing.
forest-geni.decision: Curated replacement has stocky proportions, green skin and eyes, ear bells, and leaf-bark clothing.

storm-bull.subject: An immense quadrupedal bull about eight feet at the shoulder, with a glistening silvery hide, long pearly horns, and a mist-tipped tail near Ilaya Taipa and Shard.
storm-bull.decision: Variant 2 is the only strong close representation of the silvery supernatural quadruped. The bare image is a weapon-bearing minotaur, variant 3 is a mounted rider, and variant 1 makes the subject too small and indistinct for radar cards.

swamp-troll.subject: A tall, ungainly humanoid conglomeration of branches, leaves, mud, and foulness inhabiting swamps and fens.
swamp-troll.decision: Variants 1 and 3 are strong humanoid swamp creatures coated in mud and plant matter. Variant 2 is a snake and variant 4 is a largely bare cave troll with the wrong habitat cues.

cutthroat.canonicalDescription: A human failed newcomer to The Crossing who survives as common urban criminal scum and watches passersby's money pouches.
cutthroat.decision: Curated replacement is the only human urban criminal; old variants are monsters.

beltunumshi.canonicalDescription: A central bark-covered stump surrounded by whirling vines, with old scorch marks, malevolent eyes, and a gaping maw.
beltunumshi.decision: Curated replacement has stump, vines, scorch marks, eyes, and maw.

animated-items.canonicalDescription: A combat encounter made from independently animated adzes, augers, chisels, files, hammers, and screwdrivers.
canonicalTraits: adze, auger, chisel, file, hammer, and screwdriver
animated-items.decision: The curated replacement depicts the tools themselves as the hostile animated encounter.

ember-bull.canonicalDescription: An enormous deep-red quadrupedal bull with flame running along its hide and horns, exhaling ash and cinders.
ember-bull.decision: The curated replacement uniquely combines the correct bull anatomy, scale, fire-lined hide and horns, ash, and cinders.

nipoh-oshu.canonicalDescription: An amorphous cloud of swirling steam with crude vapor limbs and two malevolent eyes glaring from within.
nipoh-oshu.decision: The curated replacement is the first candidate that is entirely vapor while retaining readable limbs and embedded eyes.

rock-guardian.canonicalDescription: A roughly twenty-foot humanoid granite construct with massive fists and feet, deliberate graceful movement, and an almost sad face.
rock-guardian.decision: The curated replacement fixes the former bird-shaped rock formations and provides the canonical monumental humanoid body.

windbag.canonicalDescription: A floating globular mass of shredded moonsilk and textiles with a tightly coiled head, glowing eyes, and torn ribbon-claw appendages.
windbag.decision: The curated replacement restores the floating textile body, glowing eyes, and long torn cloth claws absent from both yarn-ball candidates.

s-kra-kor-shaman.canonicalDescription: A twisted black-scaled S'Kra Mur shaman in deep robes, with a visible long tail, glowing eyes, and bony clawed hands tracing destructive magic.
s-kra-kor-shaman.decision: The curated replacement is recognizably S'Kra Mur and preserves the hood, tail, claws, and hostile magic.

s-kra-kor-villager.canonicalDescription: A hideously twisted S'Kra Mur villager with glistening black scales, reptilian anatomy, claws, and a long tail.
s-kra-kor-villager.decision: The curated replacement corrects both former human renders while keeping the subject visibly unarmored and villager-like.

s-kra-kor-warrior.canonicalDescription: A hideously twisted and heavily muscled S'Kra Mur warrior with glistening black scales, clawed hands, and a wickedly spiked tail.
s-kra-kor-warrior.decision: The curated replacement fixes the minotaur body-plan error and clearly preserves black scales, claws, and the spiked reptilian tail.

sylph.canonicalDescription: A whirling mass of shredded silk and textiles animated by Air into a lithe humanoid form with glowing eyes and razor-sharp tatter claws.
sylph.decision: Elanthipedia resolved the ambiguity; the curated replacement matches the moonsilk textile construct rather than either human candidate.

ur-hhrki-izh.canonicalDescription: An ancient S'Kra Mur whose organs are gone, leaving desiccated scaly skin over a reptilian skeleton and sullen fires in empty eye sockets.
ur-hhrki-izh.decision: The curated replacement is the first reptilian full-body skeleton with stretched scale remnants, burning sockets, and a long tail.
